recentItems.title: యాక్సిడెంటల్‌గా రామోజీరావును కలిశాను | Amit Shah Recalls His First Meeting With CBN And Ramoji Rao
recentItems.description:
CM N. Chandrababu Naidu, Union Home Minister Amit Shah, AP Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan, Union Minister G. Kishan Reddy, and other dignitaries lit the ceremonial lamp at the Ramoji Excellence Awards 2026 event. On the occasion of Ramoji Rao’s birth anniversary on November 16, The Ramoji Group is presenting the prestigious Ramoji Excellence Awards to recognise outstanding contributions across various fields. The awards honour achievers in journalism, arts and culture, rural development, agriculture, science and technology, social service, women empowerment, youth leadership, education and healthcare. After evaluating the contributions of hundreds of individuals from across India, the Ramoji Group is selecting deserving awardees for this special recognition. Each award recipient will receive a memento, a certificate of appreciation and a cash prize of ₹10 lakh, recognising their exceptional contribution to society.
